messages:
Maya Chen: paging: ALB->envoy connection-reset spike in euc2-b, lots of 5xx on /v1/generate from hosted API. seeing error bursts starting ~5m ago. on-call please.
infra-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT: 1940001234 - ALB/Envoy connection resets in euc2-b. PagerDuty notified to oncall-rotation. Escalation policy: infra -> eng-sre.
Maya Chen: logs show Envoy upstream resets (RST_STREAM) and backend target health flapping. ALB targetgroup 10.2.* showing 50% unhealthy in az-b. ?cause maybe noisy NICs in euc2-b or host-level kernel conntrack.
Josh Patel: digging into metrics. Cloudwatch: ALB 5xx rate up 18% over baseline, request latency up. NLB error counters also elevated for a subset of backend instances. starting health-check replacement for targetgroup.
Rachel Ng: I can take primary triage. Maya can you dump an example curl with headers/timeouts? need to repro.
Maya Chen: posted a sample: ```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'``` response shows TLS handshake then Immediate RST from upstream.
Liam O'Neill: checking instance-level nets. SSH'd into one host in euc2-b, `dmesg` shows repeated "eth0: link reset" messages. Could be hypervisor network maintenance or noisy drivers.
Josh Patel: meanwhile increasing ALB routing weight away from euc2 to euc1 (weighted routing via Route53 failover) to reduce customer impact. Apply change now.
deploy-bot: route53 change submitted: set weighted routing: euc1 weight 90, euc2 weight 10. Change ID: Z3ABCD1234. Propagating.
Rachel Ng: running `kubectl get pods -n ingress --selector=app=envoy -o wide` to identify restarts; will restart envoy pods in euc2 to clear dirty state.
Maya Chen: quick mitigation: reduce keepalive on ALB health checks? Or replace targets with warmed instances in euc2-c. Thoughts?
Josh Patel: health-check tweak: set interval 10s, healthy threshold 2 to fail faster and shift traffic.
Rachel Ng: exec into envoy pod and check config: some upstreams marked "forced_egress". Restarting envoy daemonset in euc2 zone now: ```kubectl rollout restart ds/envoy -n ingress --field-selector spec.nodeSelector.beta.kubernetes.io/zone=euc2-b``` will post if succeeds.
oncall-rotation: acknowledged. I'm pausing the escalation to infra until we know if host-level power maintenance is happening. Contacting cloud provider support for euc2-b network host alerts.
Liam O'Neill: found a retention: `sysctl -a | grep conntrack` shows conntrack.max near threshold on a couple of nodes. Flows spike when ALB sends large burst. Trying to bump conntrack and clear table on affected nodes.
Maya Chen: customer impact: approx 12% of requests for hosted API hitting euc2-b failing, rolling average 7min window. External status page updated: "Partial degradation in euc2 region; some requests may return 5xx". Posting link: https://status.redwood.example/incident/1940001234
Josh Patel: cloud support responded: "We observed NIC queue stalls on hypervisor, will migrate instances away from problematic hosts." They initiated live host evacuation for 3 hosts in euc2-b.
Rachel Ng: after envoy restart and conntrack bump, 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 6% in euc2-b. ALB health shows more healthy targets now. Keep monitoring for 15m.
deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline: no recent control-plane deploys to ingress in last 2 hours. Confirmed.
Maya Chen: handing off to Rachel for next hour to monitor and coordinate with cloud provider. I'm switching to postmortem owner if we stabilize.
Rachel Ng: taking primary. I'll keep the thread updated. Next steps: confirm host evacuations completed, validate connection resets cleared, capture metrics and timeline, draft postmortem template.
Josh Patel: can someone capture the exact commands used to bump conntrack and the restart so we put them in the incident notes?
Liam O'Neill: commands: ```sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144
ss -s | grep conntrack
sudo conntrack -F
kubectl rollout restart ds/envoy -n ingress -l app=envoy --grace-period=30
``` verified on nodes i-0abc123 and i-0def456.
oncall-rotation: marking incident as "mitigated" in PagerDuty but keep monitoring. Incident timeline: start=1940001234, mitigation=1940001360. Leaving oncall for followup to Rachel.
Maya Chen: agreed. Postmortem owners: infra-team (Rachel) + networking (Liam). I'll draft initial summary and assign docs.
Rachel Ng: adding note: communicate to affected customers via support channel with ETA and rollback options. cc @support-team.
Maya Chen: thanks everyone. will circulate a short blameless summary and schedule a 1hr postmortem session tomorrow.
infra-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED: 1940001234 - mitigated. Final status: partial degradation resolved; host-level network hardware issue identified in euc2-b and instances evacuated. Postmortem assigned to Rachel Ng and Liam O'Neill."
